from pathlib import Path
import base64,contextlib,datetime,hashlib,io,json,subprocess,sys,types,zlib
root=Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
target=root/'delivery/checkpoint002_roundtrip/ARC_Independent_Lab'
remote=root/'delivery/checkpoint002_roundtrip/remote.git'
source=root/'scripts/checkpoint_update.py'
source_bytes=source.read_bytes();mod=types.ModuleType('checkpoint_update_regression');exec(compile(source_bytes,str(source),'exec'),mod.__dict__)
mod.REMOTE=str(remote);mod.canonical_target=lambda:target
sha=lambda b:hashlib.sha256(b).hexdigest()
def git(*args):
 p=subprocess.run(['git','-C',str(target),*args],capture_output=True)
 if p.returncode:
  event={'ts':datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat(),'command':list(args),'exit_code':p.returncode,'stdout':p.stdout.decode(errors='replace'),'stderr':p.stderr.decode(errors='replace'),'scope':'synthetic index regression only'}
  with (root/'evidence/CHECKPOINT_UPDATE_REGRESSION_ERRORS_2026-09-06.jsonl').open('a') as f:f.write(json.dumps(event)+'\n')
  raise RuntimeError(p.stderr.decode(errors='replace'))
 return p.stdout
base='189f424e5cc9588d9774fd58850c44c9b182f813'
head=git('rev-parse','HEAD').decode().strip()
assert git('status','--porcelain')==b'', 'Fixture must start clean'
base_names=set(git('ls-tree','-r','--name-only',base).decode().splitlines())
names=git('diff-tree','--no-commit-id','--name-only','--no-renames','-r',base,head).decode().splitlines()
files={}
for name in names:
 if name==mod.ERROR_LOG:continue
 new=git('show',head+':'+name)
 if name==mod.ESCALATION:
  assert new.endswith(mod.ANSWER.encode());new=new[:-len(mod.ANSWER.encode())]
 old=git('show',base+':'+name) if name in base_names else None
 files[name]={'old_sha256':sha(old) if old is not None else None,'sha256':sha(new),'base64':base64.b64encode(new).decode()}
package=mod.unpack(base64.b64encode(zlib.compress(json.dumps({'base_commit':base,'files':files}).encode())).decode())
name='scripts/run_reproduction.py';assert files[name]['old_sha256'] is None
body=(target/name).read_bytes();before_status=git('status','--porcelain')
git('rm','--cached','--',name)
status_deleted=git('diff','--cached','--name-status').decode()
assert (target/name).read_bytes()==body
output=io.StringIO();error=None
try:
 try:
  with contextlib.redirect_stdout(output):mod.inspect_repository(mod.Git(target),package)
 except ValueError as e:error=str(e)
 accepted=error is None
 assert (target/name).read_bytes()==body
 staged_after=git('diff','--cached','--name-status').decode()
 assert staged_after==status_deleted, 'Preflight unexpectedly changed synthetic index'
finally:
 git('restore','--staged','--source=HEAD','--',name)
assert git('status','--porcelain')==before_status
result={'ts':datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat(),'source_sha256':sha(source_bytes),'fixture_head':head,'test_path':name,'payload_old_sha256':None,'working_file_sha256':sha(body),'staged_change':status_deleted,'preflight_accepted':accepted,'exception':error,'preflight_stdout':output.getvalue(),'index_unchanged_by_preflight':True,'working_bytes_preserved':True,'synthetic_index_restored':True,'expectation':'reject any staged deletion of an already committed payload file','expectation_satisfied':not accepted}
out=root/'delivery'/('checkpoint002_staged_deletion_'+sys.argv[1]+'.json');out.write_text(json.dumps(result,indent=2)+'\n')
print(json.dumps(result,indent=2))
